question: In which year did the Indian football team go on its first known official international tour?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1924**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian football team's **first known official international tour took place** in 1924,** led by the** legendary Indian footballer Gostha Pal**
 
• This historic tour marked the beginning of India's journey in international football. 
 
• As the team travelled abroad, t**hey played matches against various countries**, including **Ceylon (now Sri Lanka) in 1933**, where they secured a 1-0 victory ¹
 
• The I**ndian football team's maiden international tour was organized by the Indian Football Association (IFA),**
 
• India's football team toured Ceylon and Burma **winning 7, drawing 2, and losing 3 of their 12 matches**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Football History**

 
 
• Football was **introduced in India by the British in the 19th century**, marking the start of India's football journey
 
• The Indian Football Association (IFA) **was established in 1893**, laying the foundation for organized football in the country.
 
• India's football team had its **"golden era" in the 1950s-1960s,** winning two gold medals at the 1951 and 1962 Asian Games
 
• They also **finished fourth at the 1956 Summer Olympics.**
 
• After a decline, India's football team saw a resurgence in the 21st century, **winning the Nehru Cup in 2007 and 2009,** and the AFC Challenge Cup in 2008
